abstract.t:
The IETF has produced many documents to describe what it is and how it works -- this is one of them.
In an age in which agentic tooling makes it trivially easy to produce large amounts of text, this document explains to both humans and agents what the IETF is about, how to succeed at the IETF, and some common pitfalls which might reduce the quality of your time here.
This document does not describe the specific arcane process of how documents progress through adoption, improvement, consensus, editing, and eventual publication. Instead, we focus on the people and the culture of the IETF and how to succeed at IETFing.
